profit.reason: Hypothesis: independent teams coordinating several agent sessions might pay for a shared workspace; the post proves no buyers or payment.

feasibility.reason: A prototype can group fictional session notes on one canvas; connecting live agents, tools and teammates is unverified.

autonomy.reason: A proposed view could collect supplied session notes, while a person chooses what to share and resolves conflicting updates.

evidence.reason: The builder describes several sessions being scattered across tools, but supplies no recurrence, task detail or corroboration.
